verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Khoj can be self-hosted as a server via Docker or pip, and it offers in-product scheduled Automations that email results. Neither is a documented headless, scriptable mode for CI pipelines: there is no CLI, programmatic API usage or non-interactive invocation documented, and the OpenAPI probes returned 404. Scheduled Automations are a recurring in-app feature and Docker hosting is only a deployment mode, so both are adjacent rather than this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
